triggers: S-1s show revenue below run-rate but not catastrophic; Oracle free cash flow stays negative one more year; capex growth slows toward cloud revenue growth.
what_follows: The tail reprices mildly: spreads widen; Oracle and neocloud equities flat to down; the core absorbs a capex slowdown; hiring tightens first in the tail; the build continues at a slower pace.

triggers: S-1s show margins recovering; Anthropic sustains profit; revenue per $1 of compute stays above $1.50 and rising; cloud revenue outgrows capex.
what_follows: The bubble thesis dissolves; the leveraged tail rallies hardest because it was priced for distress; capex continues; the episode is re-remembered as a boom.

scenario: Bear — correction in the financing layer
triggers: S-1 booked revenue far below run-rates; Oracle downgraded; a Stargate or Abilene financing delayed or restructured; credit spreads widen materially.
what_follows: The leveraged tail reprices first as telecom vendor-financing did in 2001; neocloud or SPV defaults become possible; the profitable core absorbs a capex slowdown; the technology survives and gets cheaper.

triggers: Booked revenue less than half the quoted run-rate; Oracle cut to one notch above junk; a major financing pulled outright.
what_follows: Forced selling in the tail; stress reaches private credit and non-bank lenders; banks stay resilient under the IMF's own stress test; the repricing is sharp but contained.

triggers: Revenue per $1 of compute jumps (Anthropic's $2.08 keeps rising); a DeepSeek-style efficiency gain; custom silicon cuts costs sharply.
what_follows: Revenue arrives ahead of schedule; the Sequoia gap closes from the revenue side; the bubble thesis dissolves faster than in the Bull case; the winners are the efficient not the biggest spenders.

triggers: Interconnection queues lengthen; transformer lead times extend beyond 144 weeks; state moratoria; power prices spike.
what_follows: The build slows regardless of how much capital is available; power and grid owners gain pricing power; timelines stretch rather than collapse; the constraint nobody modelled becomes the story.
